svg.title: Detailed folder structure inside the TravelManagementSystem.Api project
svg.desc: The Api project contains Controllers, Services (including the approval workflow state machine), Repositories, Models mirroring the ER diagram entities, DTOs for API request and response shapes, a Data folder with the DbContext, and EF Core Migrations alongside Program.cs and appsettings.json.

g.text: Controllers → Services → Repositories, plus supporting folders
Models/ (EF entities, mirrors the ER diagram)
TmsDbContext.cs — DbSet properties + Fluent API config
Migrations/ — auto-generated by EF Core (do not hand-edit)
